he.text: כִּי עִמְּךָ הַסְּלִיחָה לְמַעַן תִּוָּרֵא׃ זֹאת נָשִׁיב אֶל־לִבֵּנוּ עַל־כֵּן נוֹחִיל לוֹ׃ כִּי עִם יְיָ הַחֶסֶד וְהַרְבֵּה עִמּוֹ פְדוּת׃ טוֹב יְיָ לְקֹוָו לְנֶפֶשׁ תִּדְרְשֶׁנּוּ׃

en.text: There is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared. This we will recall to our minds, and therefore we will hope. For with the Lord there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption. The Lord is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
